C2.title: The Job That Charged a Fee
C2.brief: Imran, 18, lost Rs. 5,000 to a work-from-home job. He asks where it went wrong. Review the device, and keep in mind that he was the target of a professional operation.
C2.closing: Wanting work is not a mistake. Checking before paying is the habit that protects you.
C2-M01: Did you register for the coaching test form? Last date is Friday.
C2-M02: 3 new openings match your profile: Data entry (Hyderabad), Retail assistant, Delivery partner. Apply inside the JobPort app. We never ask for fees.
C2-M02.explain: A real job portal tells you applying is free and sends you into its own app. Safe.
C2-M03.explain: Real payment alerts. They confirm the payee name: the same person both times.
C2-M05: Mock test on Sunday at 10 AM. Bring your hall ticket.
C2-M05.explain: A known coaching centre with a normal reminder. Safe.
C2-M06: Come home early today. Dinner is your favourite.
C2-M07: Recharge Rs. 239 and get 1 GB extra data this week.
C2-M07.explain: A normal plan offer under the phone company’s usual sender name. It asks for nothing secret. Safe.
C2-P02: Outgoing to 97XXXXXX08, Fri 4:20 PM, 1 min (no recording)
C2-P04: Coaching Centre, incoming, Thu 5:00 PM, 1 min
C2-CH01a: Priya: “Hi Imran! Welcome to WorkNest Global. Work from home, earn Rs. 3,000 per day. No experience needed!”
C2-CH01b:
Imran: “Is this a real company? Do you have a website?”
Priya: “Yes yes, we are a registered global company. Many students are earning daily. See the group.”
C2-CH01c: Priya: “Task 1: Like these 3 videos and send screenshots.”
C2-CH01d: Priya: “Done! Rs. 200 sent. See, we pay on time. Join our earners group.”
C2-CH01e: Priya: “Payment received. This is company confidential. Do not discuss it with your family.”
C2-CH01f:
Priya: “Last step to withdraw: pay Rs. 3,000 tax. Today only.”
Imran: “I will ask my brother first.”
Priya: “Then your money is blocked. Decide now.”
C2-CH01g: You cannot reply to this conversation.
C2-CH01p: Photo: a stock image (a faint watermark shows when zoomed). Company: WorkNest Global (no website listed). Joined ChatUp 5 days ago.
C2-CH02a: Rahul (admin): “Good morning everyone! Another great day to earn!”
C2-CH02b:
Three members post earnings screenshots:
Sneha: “Today earning Rs. 21,000”
Vijay: “Rs. 9,800 credited”
Pooja: “Rs. 14,500 withdrawn”
All three images share an identical layout and font.
C2-CH02c: Rahul (admin): “PREMIUM TASKS open now! Deposit Rs. 5,000 to unlock and get Rs. 7,500 back tonight. Offer ends today at 6 PM. Only 10 seats!”
C2-CH02d: Rules: Do not tell outsiders. Do not share screenshots outside this group.
C2-CH02e: You were removed from WorkNest Earners 12.
C2-CH03:
Imran: “Bhai, I think I found a job!”
Bhai: “Nice. Check it properly before you do anything. Show me the details tonight.”
C2-CH03.explain: Good advice. Asking someone you trust to look first is the safest move.
C2-IG01: Reel from worknest.global.jobs. Overlay: “Earn Rs. 3,000 per DAY liking videos at home! No skills. No experience. Limited seats. DM JOB now!”
C2-IG02: Bio: “Global jobs for youth”. 8 posts. 1,200 followers. No address or website.
C2-IG03: Thanks for your interest! Our HR Priya will message you on ChatUp: 97XXXXXX08.
C2-IG04: A cricket reel and a food reel.
C2-IG05: Nice reel, send me the link.
C2-PN01: Paid to Neha R. Rs. 5,000. Success.
C2-PN03.explain: Money to or from a saved person or place Imran knows. Safe.
C2-PN06: Bhai, Amma, Coaching Centre, Neha R.
C2-01.explain: Rs. 3,000 a day for liking videos is not a job. Real jobs need real skills and real work.
C2-02.explain: Yes yes, we are registered proves nothing. A real company can show a website, an address and a contract.
C2-03.explain: Paying you first makes it feel real. A small payout is bait to get a bigger payment from you.
C2-04.explain: A deadline and only 10 seats push you to pay before you think.
C2-05.explain: Real companies do not take deposits into a person’s account. A job should never ask you to pay.
C2-06.explain: Once the money is in, they remove you and go silent.
C2-G1.explain: All the earnings screenshots have the same layout. Anyone can make them. They are fake proof.
C2-G2.explain: Secret from family means nobody can say: wait, this looks wrong.
C2-X1.explain: The same person who paid him first later took his deposit. A company would not use a personal account for both.
C2-L1.q: Identify the offer that started this. What was promised, and for what work?
C2-L1.nudge: Check the social app, under Saved.
C2-L2.q: Imran asked whether the company was real. Evaluate the reply: does it contain anything verifiable?
C2-L2.nudge: Look for a website, address or registration number in the answer.
C2-L3.q: He was paid before doing meaningful work. Locate that payment and consider why an attacker would send money first.
C2-L3.nudge: Check received payments in the payment app.
C2-L4.q: A group chat added urgency. Find the message that set the deadline.
C2-L5.q: Trace the deposit. Who received it, and is that how a company collects fees?
C2-L5.nudge: Check outgoing payments and the payee name.
C2-L6.q: What happened to the group and the HR contact once he stopped paying?
C2-L6.nudge: Open the group and the chat again, after Saturday morning.
C2.fix.q: A job asks you to pay a deposit before you start. What is the correct response?
C2.fix.a: Pay quickly so he does not lose the spot.
C2.fix.a.why: No genuine employer charges you to start or to be paid. Paying quickly is what the deadline is designed to produce.
C2.fix.b: Check the company on its official website and ask a trusted adult.
C2.fix.b.why: Correct. Verify the company through a source you find yourself and involve a trusted adult before any payment.
C2.fix.c: Ask HR to send more screenshots.
C2.fix.c.why: Screenshots are trivial to fabricate, as the identical earnings images show.
C2.replay.1: Bait: Rs. 3,000 a day for liking videos.
C2.replay.2: Pretext: a small early payout and fabricated earnings screenshots as social proof.
C2.replay.3: Pressure: a deadline, ten seats, and an instruction to keep it from family.
C2.replay.4: Extraction: a Rs. 5,000 deposit to a personal account.
C2.replay.5: Exit: removed from the group, chat closed.
C2.debrief.mechanism: A small early payout (Rs. 200) creates reciprocity and the belief that the scheme is real. Fabricated earnings screenshots add social proof, and a deadline pushes the larger deposit. The same personal account both paid out and collected the deposit, which no company would do. A request for a further tax follows because people who have already paid tend to keep paying (the sunk-cost effect).
C2.debrief.c1: No genuine employer charges a fee to start work or to release pay.
C2.debrief.c2: Check who receives the money. A personal name is not a company.
C2.debrief.c3: Talk to someone before you pay. Requests for secrecy exist to defeat exactly this check.
C2-CH01c.explain: The task is the cover story. Simple, easy work makes the later payout look earned.
